hero.title: Audit-ready AML screening, engineered to refuse silent false-clears.
hero.subhead: Klirs is an open-source screening engine for Latvian and EU compliance buyers. Every verdict carries timestamped source-page screenshots, a transparent risk score, and pre-filled Latvian Bar Association annexes. Hosted version launches late May.

audit.title: Read every line that produced your evidence.
audit.quote: Read, run, and audit every line that produced your evidence. No vendor can hide a sanctions-list omission behind a black box.
audit.body: Klirs is licensed under AGPL-3.0. The dual-affirmative classifier means a clear verdict requires positive proof from the source page — silent false-clears on sanctioned entities are a contract violation, not a quiet bug. Proprietary competitors structurally cannot make this claim.

forWhom.title: Who Klirs is for.
forWhom.advokatiBody: P2, P3.1, and P3.2 annexes pre-filled from each verdict. Drop straight into the client file. Methodology is auditable line-by-line if the Bar Council asks.
forWhom.complianceBody: EU + UN + US + UK + AU sanctions plus Latvian PEP and adverse media in one screening. Timestamped evidence trail your auditor will accept 18 months later.
forWhom.vaspBody: Onboarding-grade screening at the speed your queue demands. Per-screening pricing means your unit economics survive a busy month.

registers.title: Anchored in Latvian compliance reality.
registers.body: Data sources: Firmas.lv (FID consolidated sanctions), VID PNP, VID VAD, Latvian Business Register (Uzņēmumu reģistrs), OFAC SDN, UK Sanctions, multilingual adverse media (LV / EN / RU / ET). Aligned with EU AML6 and Padomes Instrukcija NILLTPFN-SL.

features.title: What every screening produces.
features.evidenceBody: Viewport screenshot + source URL for every check. Exported as a PDF + DOCX bundle a regulator will accept 18 months later.
features.coverageBody: OFAC SDN, UK Sanctions, EU/UN/AU consolidated, Latvian PEP / officials’ declarations, Latvian Business Register, multilingual adverse media (LV / EN / RU / ET).
features.annexBody: P2 (client identification & due diligence), P3.1 (client risk assessment), and P3.2 (enhanced due diligence) — Latvian Bar Association templates auto-populated from each verdict. Drop straight into your client file.

demoVideo.title: See it in action.
demoVideo.body: A 90-second walkthrough of an end-to-end screening — entity input through evidence-bundle export.

cta.title: Hosted version launches late May.
cta.body: Klirs is in pilot through 2026-05-08 — pricing locks after that on a hybrid seat + per-screening pack model. Sign in with your email and run your first screening in under a minute.
